props.kicker: PrideJot · a micro-journal for the LGBTQ+ community
props.title: Jot the ==good stuff==.
props.subtitle: A pocket journal for {c:#ffb86b}queer joy{/c} — the small wins, the moments of {c:#7fe3c3}euphoria{/c}, the {c:#7cc4ff}belonging{/c}.

slides.notes: Open warm. PrideJot is a joyful micro-journal made for the LGBTQ+ community — the whole deck argues that queer joy deserves a home of its own.

props.title: Journaling apps feel ==clinical==. Queer joy has ==nowhere to go==.
props.body: The small daily wins — moments of euphoria, belonging, chosen family — deserve a home of their own, not another homework assignment.

slides.notes: Name the gap: mainstream journaling tools are heavy or clinical, and the small bright moments of queer life rarely get captured anywhere.

props.title: A pocket journal for ==tiny, bright entries==.

items.title: A moment
items.body: One bright thing from today, captured in seconds — not essays.

items.title: A mood
items.body: Name the feeling, keep the memory.

items.title: A gratitude
items.body: Tiny thanks that add up, day after day.

slides.notes: What it does: three entry shapes — a moment, a mood, a gratitude. The pitch is speed: seconds, not essays.

items.title: Open
items.body: One tap from wherever you are straight to the page.

items.title: Jot a line or two
items.body: No prompts, no pressure, no blank-page dread.

items.title: Tag the feeling
items.body: Joy, pride, calm, mischief — your words.

items.title: Come back anytime
items.body: Browse your bright spots whenever you need a lift.

slides.notes: Walk the loop: open, jot a line, tag the feeling, done. Returning matters as much as writing — browsing past bright spots is the payoff.

left.label: Typical journaling apps
left.title: Clinical or heavy
points: Streaks that guilt you for missing a day
Design that reads like a medical chart

right.label: PrideJot
right.title: Rainbow warmth throughout
points: Affirming language that meets you where you are
Zero streak-shaming — your pace, your story
Built for and by the LGBTQ+ community

slides.notes: The values slide: rainbow warmth, affirming language, zero streak-shaming. PrideJot is deliberately the opposite of the guilt-driven habit tracker.

tiles.title: Seconds, not essays
tiles.body: Capture a bright moment before it slips away.

tiles.title: Feeling tags

tiles.title: Yours alone

tiles.title: A shelf of good days

tiles.title: Affirming language

slides.notes: Skim the feature grid — speed, feeling tags, privacy, the bright-spots view, affirming language. Don't read every tile; pick two and move on.
